prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beBike promotion poster with a blue-sky Saigon street background. Place the white be logo at the top center. Add large white text 'Quá xá rẻ Sài Gòn đi' and a large yellow rounded block with black text 'Đồng giá 10K'. Below, add 'Nhập mã' and a yellow coupon label 'SAIGONRE'. In the foreground place a large illustrated yellow beBike carrying two riders, with one rider in sunglasses. Add a giant smartphone on the right showing the be app ride screen with a yellow scooter icon and the text 'Di chuyển'. Include smaller scooter mascot scenes at the lower left and lower right, and a bottom footnote '*Áp dụng cho beBike/beBike Plus'. Technical style: hybrid illustrated mobility promotion poster, bright commercial daylight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
